name: Hocheder
beschreibung: The Hotel Hocheder enjoys a premier, peaceful central position on Klosterstraße in Seefeld in Tirol, right next to the spa gardens and just steps from the lively pedestrian precinct and train station. The comfortably appointed guest rooms and suites mostly feature sunny balconies framing vistas of the Wetterstein and Karwendel ranges, modern en-suite bathrooms, cable TV, and in-room safes. A dedicated wellness oasis complete with an indoor swimming pool, Finnish sauna, and steam bath provides supreme rejuvenation. A varied morning breakfast buffet and fine evening menus highlight Tyrolean culinary tradition. In winter, the internationally celebrated cross-country ski trails of the Seefeld plateau and the Rosshütte lifts are practically on the doorstep. In summer, Lake Wildsee and the historic Seekirchl church delight visitors.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally located hotel on Klosterstraße in Seefeld in Tirol featuring an indoor pool, saunas, and near the pedestrian zone.
